title: Deterministic and nondeterministic exponential-oracle classes
statement: For the oracle language $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$, the class of languages decidable in polynomial time by deterministic oracle Turing machines is equal to the class decidable in polynomial time by nondeterministic oracle Turing machines: $\mathrm{P}^{\mathrm{EXPCOM}}=\mathrm{NP}^{\mathrm{EXPCOM}}$.
replaced:
For the oracle language $	ext{EXPCOM}$, the class of languages decidable in polynomial
time by deterministic oracle Turing machines equals the class of languages decidable in
polynomial time by nondeterministic oracle Turing machines:
$	ext{P}^{	ext{EXPCOM}}=	ext{NP}^{	ext{EXPCOM}}$.
